mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNBBSMASTER (BBS_ID, BBS_TY_CODE, BBS_NM, BBS_INTRCN, REPLY_POSBL_AT, FILE_ATCH_POSBL_AT, ATCH_POSBL_FILE_NUMBER, TMPLAT_ID, USE_AT, CMMNTY_ID, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, BLOG_ID, BLOG_AT, CATEGORY_MAIN, CATEGORY_SCOPE) VALUES (#{bbsId}, #{bbsTyCode}, #{bbsNm}, #{bbsIntrcn}, #{replyPosblAt}, #{fileAtchPosblAt}, #{atchPosblFileNumber}, #{tmplatId}, #{useAt}, #{cmmntyId}, #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE, #{blogId}, #{blogAt}, #{categoryMain}, #{categoryScope})
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(a.BBS_ID) FROM COMTNBBSMASTER a LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE bt ON bt.CODE_ID='COM101' AND bt.USE_AT='Y' AND bt.CODE=a.BBS_TY_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND a.CMMNTY_ID = #{cmmntyId}
AND a.BBS_NM LIKE '%'||#{searchWrd}||'%'
AND a.BBS_INTRCN LIKE '%'||#{searchWrd}||'%'

SELECT a.BBS_ID, a.BBS_TY_CODE, bt.CODE_NM AS BBS_TY_CODE_NM, a.BBS_NM, a.BBS_INTRCN, a.TMPLAT_ID, tpl.TMPLAT_NM, tpl.TMPLAT_COURS, a.FILE_ATCH_POSBL_AT, a.ATCH_POSBL_FILE_NUMBER, a.ATCH_POSBL_FILE_SIZE, a.REPLY_POSBL_AT, a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, usr.USER_NM AS FRST_REGISTER_NM, a.CMMNTY_ID, a.USE_AT, TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, a.CATEGORY_MAIN, cm.CODE_NM AS CATEGORY_MAIN_NM, a.CATEGORY_SCOPE, cs.CODE_NM AS CATEGORY_SCOPE_NM, (SELECT NVL(USE_AT,'N') FROM COMTNBBSUSE WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND TRGET_ID IN (#{uniqId}, 'SYSTEM_DEFAULT_BOARD')) AS AUTH_FLAG, a.BLOG_ID FROM COMTNBBSMASTER a LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE bt ON bt.CODE_ID='COM101' AND bt.USE_AT='Y' AND bt.CODE=a.BBS_TY_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTNTMPLATINFO tpl ON tpl.TMPLAT_ID = a.TMPLAT_ID LEFT JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER usr ON usr.ESNTL_ID = a.FRST_REGISTER_ID LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE cm ON cm.CODE_ID='COM104' AND cm.USE_AT='Y' AND cm.CODE=a.CATEGORY_MAIN LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE cs ON cs.CODE_ID='COM105' AND cs.USE_AT='Y' AND cs.CODE=a.CATEGORY_SCOPE WHERE a.BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNBBSMASTER SET BBS_NM = #{bbsNm}, BBS_INTRCN = #{bbsIntrcn}, BBS_TY_CODE = #{bbsTyCode}, FILE_ATCH_POSBL_AT = #{fileAtchPosblAt}, ATCH_POSBL_FILE_NUMBER = #{atchPosblFileNumber}, ATCH_POSBL_FILE_SIZE = #{atchPosblFileSize}, TMPLAT_ID = #{tmplatId}, CATEGORY_MAIN = #{categoryMain}, CATEGORY_SCOPE = #{categoryScope}, LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = SYSDATE, USE_AT = #{useAt} WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
UPDATE COMTNBBSMASTER SET USE_AT = 'N', LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{lastUpdusrId}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM= SYSDATE WHERE BBS_ID = #{bbsId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNBLOG a LEFT JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER usr ON usr.ESNTL_ID = a.FRST_REGISTER_ID LEFT JOIN COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE dc ON dc.CODE_ID='COM001' AND dc.CODE = a.REGIST_SE_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS se ON se.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = a.FRST_REGISTER_ID WHERE dc.CODE_ID='COM001'
AND a.BLOG_NM LIKE '%'||#{searchWrd}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNBLOGUSER (BLOG_ID, EMPLYR_ID, MNGR_AT, SBSCRB_DE, MBER_STTUS, USE_AT, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID) VALUES (#{blogId}, #{emplyrId}, #{mngrAt}, SYSDATE, #{mberSttus}, #{useAt}, SYSDATE, #{frstRegisterId})

INSERT INTO COMTNBLOG (BLOG_ID, BLOG_NM, BLOG_INTRCN, REGIST_SE_CODE, TMPLAT_ID, USE_AT, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, BBS_ID, BLOG_AT) VALUES (#{blogId}, #{blogNm}, #{blogIntrcn}, #{registSeCode}, #{tmplatId}, #{useAt}, #{frstRegisterId}, SYSDATE, #{bbsId}, #{blogAt})
mapper.select: SELECT BLOG_ID, BBS_ID, BLOG_NM, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM COMTNBLOG WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC
SELECT BBS_ID, BBS_TY_CODE, BBS_NM, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM FROM COMTNBBSMASTER WHERE USE_AT = 'Y' ORDER BY FRST_REGIST_PNTTM DESC
